description: The Library's Virtual Desk boundary, as plugin hooks answered by the compiled kernel at bin/library (S37). CANONICAL, in the Codex layout: events nest under the top-level "hooks" key, because Codex accepts only "description" or "hooks" at the root and rejects the whole file with 'unknown field `PreToolUse`' if an event is placed there. Each matcher is the union of the tool names both harnesses give the guarded operation, so one file guards either -- Basic Memory's included, which Claude Code names `mcp__basic-memory__<tool>` and Codex, spelling a server's hyphens as underscores, `mcp__basic_memory__<tool>` (S38). Claude's form is GENERATED from this file by tools/PluginPackage.ps1 and differs in two mechanical ways: the plugin root variable is ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, and every --reader-tool-prefix -- the Desk hook's and both Shelf guards', each of which names the reader -- is the plugin's composed name. A Windows release renders this file with `& ` before each command, because Codex runs a hook through powershell.exe there (measured, codex-cli 0.153.4). Do not hand-edit a generated copy; plugin.generated-files-match fails the gate on a drift.
